name: Roland JD-08
description: Roland Boutique JD-08 (JD-800 model), from the control changes in the MIDI Implementation Chart of its Reference Manual.

sources.title: JD-08 Reference Manual, MIDI Implementation Chart (version 1.00, Oct. 13, 2021)
sources.notes: Control Change list read by tools/profiles/roland/read-cc-list.mjs from JD-08_reference_eng01_W.pdf, page 59 (sha256 5dfe1f8ea9ef816e4954b625809c4e0034766db856c1bc36f888830e5801c349), https://static.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/JD-08_reference_eng01_W.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-cc-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/cc-synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a controller the manual lists, on the number it gives, with the name it prints. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Roland prints no value ranges for these controllers, so each is 0 - 127 on the wire unless a note below says the manual prints otherwise; a switch is a number until the instrument shows where its positions fall.
4 controller(s) the chart marks as transmitted only are read-only: a panel can follow them, and they are never sent.
CC 9 is named "TVF RESONANCE": printed "TVF RESONANSE", a misprint
CC 72 is 0 - 108: the chart prints "(RX: 0-108)": the instrument receives 0 - 108 on this controller

coverage.editBufferDumpRequest: notAvailable: the instrument publishes no way to read its settings
coverage.inboundControllers: every controller the chart marks as transmitted is a parameter, so a panel can follow the front panel
